visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler boy with short dark hair sits in a grey high chair, wearing a cream-colored sweater and a tan silicone bib. He has traces of milk or food around his mouth. He looks curiously to his left in a brightly lit indoor home setting. (2) The boy turns his head to look directly at the camera with wide eyes. A digital loading icon appears on his forehead, and variety-show style text appears at the top. (3) The boy attempts to wink at the camera by squinting his eyes and tilting his head slightly, trying to follow the instruction to 'flirt' or wink. Heart-shaped bokeh effects briefly float across the frame. (4) The boy's eyes become heavy and he eventually closes them tightly, leaning his head forward as if falling asleep. Large bold text appears over his face indicating a system failure. (5) A small circular inset in the middle left shows a woman in a black blazer smiling. The boy remains in the high chair, looking drowsy and blinking slowly.
